indexComparison.implementation: One compile-time stable sorted table for both phases; one binary search on a two-byte prefix retains each phase's first full-signature/length/guard match. BMFF uses a single ranked brand scan; ZIP/CFB/XML/text avoid temporary collections.
indexComparison.timingScope: Warm Node V8 WASM and shared browser ABI; excludes file reads, compilation and instantiation. Alternate previous/current order after three warmups, eleven trials per group. Repeat each trial in batches targeting 10 ms, at most 128 repetitions, and normalize to one corpus sweep. Includes sampling, structural parsing, host calls and output decoding; not an isolated lookup benchmark or browser cold-start measurement.

corpus.labeling: Original conversion manifest/fixture suffix; additional repository fixture suffix; external upstream fixture suffix. Not an independent content audit.
limitations: Development and regression corpus, not a held-out accuracy test.
Upstream test fixtures can be minimal or intentionally incomplete; suffix labels do not establish full validity.
Container/family matches never count as exact, and precise different types are not forgiven for sharing a container.
Added 2048 deterministic random negatives and prose lookalikes; these do not estimate a real-world false-positive rate.
